name: Portfolio Analytics Pipeline
tagline: Airflow + dbt ELT from Yahoo Finance to a Metabase dashboard in Docker

children.title: Data sources
children.summary: Daily stock prices from Yahoo Finance, plus a small static CSV describing the portfolio's holdings.

children.title: Yahoo Finance prices
children.summary: Daily OHLCV prices for five tickers: AAPL, MSFT, GOOG, JPM and C, pulled with the yfinance library.

children.title: Holdings seed CSV
children.summary: Shares, cost basis, purchase date and sector per ticker, loaded into the warehouse with dbt seed.

children.title: Python ingestion
children.summary: extract_data.py pulls prices and appends them to the raw schema as-is. Cleanup happens later inside the warehouse (ELT).

children.title: Pick a date window
children.summary: Defaults to the last 5 days. A --backfill flag loads a year of history, and custom start/end dates also work.

children.title: Fetch each ticker
children.summary: Downloads one ticker at a time so a single failure is logged and skipped instead of killing the run.

children.title: Normalize columns
children.summary: Flattens yfinance's multi-level columns, lowercases names, and stamps each row with ticker and extracted_at.

children.title: Append to raw table
children.summary: Creates the raw schema if needed and appends to raw.stock_prices. Duplicates are allowed here and removed in dbt.

children.title: Airflow orchestration
children.summary: One DAG runs the four steps in order on weekdays at 18:00, labeled 6 PM EST after market close. Retries once after 2 minutes.
children.detail: Cron 0 18 * * 1-5 with catchup off. Each task is a BashOperator, and dbt runs against a docker target inside the Airflow containers.

children.title: ingest_stock_data
children.summary: Runs the Python extractor against the Postgres container.

children.title: dbt_seed
children.summary: Loads the holdings CSV into the analytics schema.

children.title: dbt_run
children.summary: Builds all five models from raw to the star schema.

children.title: dbt_test
children.summary: Runs the data quality tests last, so a bad load shows up as a failed task in Airflow.

children.title: Postgres warehouse
children.summary: PostgreSQL 15 with a raw schema for untouched data and an analytics schema for dbt output.

children.title: raw schema
children.summary: raw.stock_prices, append-only and never modified by dbt.

children.title: analytics schema
children.summary: Where dbt writes the seed, the views and the final tables that the dashboard reads.

children.title: Metabase app database
children.summary: Metabase keeps its own settings and saved dashboard in Postgres too, instead of a local file.

children.title: dbt medallion models
children.summary: Five dbt models move data from Bronze (raw) to Silver (clean + enriched) to Gold (star schema). Views in the middle, tables at the end.

children.title: Bronze: raw source
children.summary: raw.stock_prices declared as a dbt source, exactly as received.

children.title: Silver: clean + enrich
children.summary: Staging views clean and dedupe; an intermediate view adds moving averages and daily returns.

children.title: stg_stock_prices
children.summary: Casts types, drops null rows, and keeps only the latest load per date and ticker using row_number().
children.detail: Adds a stock_id surrogate key (date + ticker). This is what makes re-running ingestion safe.

children.title: stg_portfolio_holdings
children.summary: Casts the seed's shares, cost basis and purchase date to proper types.

children.title: int_stock_prices_enriched
children.summary: SQL window functions add 50-day and 200-day moving averages and daily return % per ticker.

children.title: Gold: star schema
children.summary: One dimension and one fact table, materialized as tables for the dashboard.

children.title: dim_companies
children.summary: One row per company: ticker, name, sector and exchange (NASDAQ or NYSE).

children.title: fct_portfolio_valuation
children.summary: One row per trading day per ticker: price, moving averages, market value, cost and unrealized P&L in dollars and %.

children.title: dbt data tests
children.summary: 26 schema tests across all five models, run by Airflow after every build.

children.title: unique
children.summary: Keys stay unique: stock_id in staging, one holding per ticker, one row per company.

children.title: not_null
children.summary: Dates, tickers, prices, shares, market value and P&L can never be empty.

children.title: accepted_values
children.summary: Tickers must be one of the five tracked symbols and exchange must be NASDAQ or NYSE.

children.title: relationships
children.summary: Every ticker in the fact table must exist in dim_companies, which checks the star schema's join key.

children.title: Metabase dashboard
children.summary: A Portfolio Analytics dashboard reading from the Gold tables, with five charts.

children.title: Total portfolio value
children.summary: Number card with the latest day's market value.

children.title: Value over time
children.summary: Line chart of portfolio value across all five tickers.

children.title: Unrealized P&L by stock
children.summary: Bar chart of profit or loss per position.

children.title: AAPL moving averages
children.summary: Close price against the 50-day and 200-day averages.

children.title: Sector allocation
children.summary: Pie chart of Technology vs Financials.

children.title: Docker environment
children.summary: Everything runs locally from one docker-compose file, so the whole stack is reproducible with a single command.

children.title: Postgres container
children.summary: postgres:15-alpine with a health check that the other services wait on.

children.title: Airflow containers
children.summary: Init, webserver and scheduler on Airflow 2.7.2 with SequentialExecutor. DAGs, scripts and dbt project are mounted in.
children.detail: Pinned multitasking==0.0.10 to fix a Python 3.8 compatibility issue, and gave webserver and scheduler a shared secret key.

children.title: Metabase container
children.summary: Serves the dashboard, backed by its own Postgres database.

children.title: pgAdmin
children.summary: Browser tool for poking at raw and analytics tables by hand.

children.title: Env-based config
children.summary: Credentials come from a .env file that's gitignored, with a committed .env.example template.

children.title: Claude Code guide
children.summary: CLAUDE.md gives Claude Code the architecture and house rules: explain every decision, keep patterns simple.
